scientific_integrity: All infinite-dimensional assertions are supported by the explicit operator-matrix proof; numerical and finite rational checks are supplementary. No independent mathematical validation was undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Proves hyponormality only for the symbol \(az+bz\bar z^{2}\) on analytic weighted Bergman disks with \(\alpha>-1\). Does not classify subnormality, arbitrary mixed symbols, higher degrees, or the full spectrum of the self-commutator. An unindexed historical equivalent remains a priority risk.
title: A universal sharp hyponormality threshold for the first mixed-angular Bergman Toeplitz pair
